written_results_this_segment: Weyl-covariant 1-RQLS(10) is exactly the problem of a vector unbiased to three Weyl eigenbases. Every solution is automatically maximal. There are exactly two Clifford classes, B=(Z,X,XZ) and A=(Z,X,XZ^3). The C^5 plane/Bloch reduction gives odd-sum, H-pair, mixed-pair and Dic3-symmetric exclusions.
Classes A and B are Galois conjugate (zeta20 -> zeta20^7). With I1 real emptiness, a class-A solution field has no real place over sqrt5 -> -sqrt5.

Exactly two NEB index groups exist in d=10 (with J1): abelian, and the new non-abelian dihedral G_d with explicit NEB {I,sz} x D5 and {sx,sy} x D5 Pi5. Its orbit family gives exact system (5.1) with convolution cross terms. Its even slice equals the Weyl even slice, its qubit marginal is forced (E1), and its two classes are Galois conjugate. Every H-pair plane fails because a 5th root of unity is never +-i (E1 Theorem 2.2). Maximality has two explicit eigenvector types still to exclude.
For the Weyl E+F+marginal core, no solution plane is invariant under F5 (checkpoint only).
